title: Comparing entering Customer Cash Receipts in Dynamics GP to Dynamics 365 Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: Cash receipts entry in Dynamics GP
Cash receipt journals in Business Central

features.name: Cash Receipt Journals
features.description: A feature in Business Central that allows users to record customer payments by selecting the customer, navigating to the apply to document number column, selecting outstanding invoices from a lookup, and automatically defaulting the payment amount.

features.name: Customer Register Payments Window
features.description: An alternative window in Business Central for recording customer payments that displays all outstanding invoices for all customers, allows filtering by customer, selecting multiple invoices, and posting as a lumpsum payment.

features.name: Automatic Amount and Date Defaulting
features.description: Business Central automatically defaults the payment amount and date received when a customer payment is recorded against an invoice.

features.name: Lumpsum Payment Posting
features.description: Business Central allows posting multiple invoice payments as a single lumpsum payment by selecting multiple invoices and posting them together.
